notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a hint after dying to Lazy Daisy explaining how to disable her.
[*] Fixed a bug that incorrectly counted completed challenges.
[*] Reduced the number of tasks required to complete level in Challenge Mode.
[*] Increased enemy difficulty in Challenge Mode levels.
[*] Reduced enemy movement speed in the story mode level with the basement.
[/list]
